messages:
maria_p: Heads-up: EDU pilot asked for an exemption: time-limited unlimited burst credits (6 weeks), a 99.9 SLA during the pilot, and automatic rollback to standard tier afterwards. They say it's essential for adoption.
aj: Unlimited is risky. Need telemetry + kill-switch. Is this paid?
maria_p: It's paid but minimal commit. CTO willing to consider if it's a defined, auto-terminating add-on.
kevin_r: Product idea: a 'pilot surge' add-on with declared allocation, soft-limit warnings, and hard throttle at 120% of allocation. Timebox it.
siobhan: Legal note: we should avoid 'unlimited' in contracts. What's our stance on SLA elevation?
legal-bot: Draft clause: "Pilot Surge Addendum: Provider will enable a time-limited surge allocation for Customer during the Pilot Period. Provider will monitor usage and may impose automated throttles if usage exceeds 120% of the agreed pilot allocation to protect platform stability. Provider will notify Customer 24 hours before hard throttling. No refunds will be issued for throttled usage during escalated events caused by misuse or abuse."
legal-bot: Also: we can't promise upgraded SLA unless dedicated/reserved capacity or a penalty structure is in contract.
emma_fin: Finance: with small commit we need explicit per-token surcharge beyond declared allocation. Can't absorb open-ended marginal cost.
nathan_ops: Ops: prefer reusing dedicated pool tooling + tagging. Need console kill-switch with audit trail and a pre-signed PO + spike contact required.
aj: Checklist: timeboxed window, telemetry gating, declared allocation in contract, surcharge for overage, kill-switch + ops playbook, legal addendum template, launch criteria (smoke tests + canary).
kevin_r: UI: console banner while pilot surge active, per-route rate view, single-click terminate for ops/support.
siobhan: Launch criteria: no latency regressions under pilot load tests, cost guardrails, day-1 internal alerts to product/ops/finance, rollback plan.
maria_p: Decision point: SKU (pilot-surge) vs one-off contract clause. Thoughts?
emma_fin: SKU preferred for repeatability and pricing integrity; avoids endless exceptions.
legal-bot: We'll produce a templated addendum with placeholders: pilot dates, allocation, surcharge, notification window, kill-switch steps.
nathan_ops: Tech: tagging + quota enforcement doable in ~2 sprints if scoped narrowly; runtime needs TTL on allocations and throttle hook.
aj: Engineering requirement: throttle response should be graceful (structured 429 with 'pilot-throttled' code) to avoid confusing apps.
kevin_r: We'll standardize error schema and update SDK docs.
siobhan: Timeline: draft addendum + SKU pricing EOW, ops/eng spike next week (2 sprints), legal sign-off week after, target pilot launch in 4 weeks.
maria_p: Messaging to EDU: 'time-limited pilot surge to evaluate scale' with clear conversion path to Priority/Reserved tiers.
emma_fin: Add conversion incentive: if customer converts within 12 weeks, credit part of surcharge back as a one-time promo.
legal-bot: We can add a conditional credit clause with precise language.
aj: Any blockers?
kevin_r: Engineering capacity — mark runtime spike P1 but avoid scope creep.
siobhan: Sales enablement needed: 2-paragraph explainer, contract checklist, ops contact list.
maria_p: Actions: legal-bot -> template addendum; emma_fin -> propose surcharge bands; nathan_ops -> ops playbook + kill-switch; kevin_r -> runtime spike ticket; aj -> sales/vendor coordination. Reconvene Tue 9am. :thumbsup:
